task_anchors.task_description: Reviewing patient chart history and initiating standard chest-pain protocol (ECG) despite a history suggestive of anxiety
Interpreting borderline vitals (tachycardia, mild hypoxia) against a strong prior pattern, choosing anxiolytic treatment and deferred imaging over immediate PE workup
Incorporating new, previously undocumented symptom (calf tenderness) to revise diagnostic framework, calculate Wells score, and order D-dimer/CT
Deciding between holding the patient for imaging results versus admitting proactively under time and resource pressure, with cardiology unavailable and radiology delayed
